title: error-code ledger: name the codes for plugin-auth's eight remaining code-less hook refusals (organization create, invitation placement, slug guard, OTP walls), so #24243 can stamp each one
body:
**Filing gate ④:** the `packages/spec` half of #24243. Triage split it as it split #24082 and #23945, at `6244958324`: "any non-standard code registered first by `domain:spec` in `error-code-ledger.zod.ts`, split as #24082 / #23945 were". Filed by `domain:services` seat 1 (seat post #6021) · `marchtian` · `session_01Nk17Z26X5DB59iQztDBADH`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and `domain:*` are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:spec` seat, in one PR on `packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts`. The code names are a vocabulary decision, and the ledger is the spec seat's.

## What is asked

Name one ADR-0112 code for each refusal below. For each one, either:
- a standard code fits: name it, and no ledger row is needed; or
- register a new `@objectstack/plugin-auth` row under the synonym gate (#8211), with its meaning comment.

Each refusal is thrown today as a better-auth `APIError` with `message` alone. A client, the console among them, cannot branch on it. Read on `origin/main` `f5ef054a7` (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`):

| line | status | door | what it refuses |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `:1343` | 429 | phone OTP send (`smsQuotaExceededApiError`) | the deployment-wide SMS quota |
| `:1358` | 503 | update-organization (`slugGuardReadFaultApiError`) | the slug guard's read could not answer |
| `:3464` | 400 | create-organization hook | the reserved `__global__` id or slug (ADR-0120 D3) |
| `:3472` | 403 | create-organization hook | creating more organizations is disabled on this deployment |
| `:3540` | 403 | invitation placement hook | placement needs the delegated-administration runtime, which this deployment lacks |
| `:3558` | 403 | invitation placement hook | placement outside the issuer's delegated scope (the message is relayed from the scope check) |
| `:3668` | 403 | update-organization slug guard | changing a slug while active environments still reference it |
| `:5761` | 429 | phone OTP send (`assertPhoneOtpSendAllowed`) | the per-number send rate limit |

**Constraints to carry:**
- **`:1343` and `:5761` must carry the same code.** The header above `:1343` records #2814's requirement that the two walls be indistinguishable from outside: a caller must not learn which budget it hit. A distinct code per wall would break that.
- **`:1358` already has a precedent.** #23945 gave the invitation cap's read fault `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (503) with the code in the body. If the slug guard's fault should differ, say why.
- **`:3540` and `:3558` share a door** (`POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member`) with the invitation role cap's three codes (`INVITE_ROLE_ABOVE_ISSUER`, `INVITE_ISSUER_MEMBER_ONLY`, `INVITE_ISSUER_UNVERIFIED`, registered by #24082). The new names should read as siblings of those.

## Order

#24243 (`domain:services`, p3) stamps the codes in `plugin-auth` and adds the enumeration pin, `Blocked-by:` this card.

## Grade

p3, as #24243 and #24082: every refusal still refuses with a clear English message. Only the machine-readable code is missing.

## Dedupe

- A REST scan of the 492 most recently updated objectstack issues (open and closed) for the ledger beside `plugin-auth`, organization-create, placement, the slug guard and the OTP walls found no card that registers these codes.
- The nearest are #24243 (its parent) and #24082 (closed: the invitation role cap's three codes).

Dedupe words: error-code ledger plugin-auth organization create disabled; invitation placement code; slug guard active environments code; phone OTP rate limit code.
